bullets.text: Residents in Tiruvallur protested on the road at midnight due to continuous power cuts, and the office should monitor power infrastructure.
A sudden road subsidence near Nehru Nagar caused traffic disruptions in Velachery, and the office should coordinate urgent repairs.
The meteorological department issued an orange alert for Tiruvallur due to Cyclone Murasu, and the office should oversee disaster preparedness.
Large crowds gathered in Velachery for Diwali shopping causing severe traffic congestion, and the office should manage crowd control.
Minister Pussys Anand inaugurated a marathon in Besant Nagar to raise drug awareness among youth, and the office should support anti-drug initiatives.
Students and parents expressed concern over overgrown bushes and venomous creatures at a panchayat union school in Tiruttani, and the office should direct school cleanup.
Southern Railway announced a new suburban electric train schedule from Thiruvallur to Moore Market Complex starting November 1, and the office should review commuter benefits.
Tiruvallur residents raised safety concerns over damaged and missing concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar road over bridge, and the office should urge repairs.
The Tamil Nadu government launched a master plan to provide single window civic solutions so citizens do not have to wander, and the office should track rollout.
Larsen and Toubro started construction of a 52MW data center in Chennai for AI infrastructure, and the office should support tech investments.
MEIL projects division president K stressed that modern construction methods and AI-based planning improve infrastructure quality, and the office should encourage digital adoption.
The TVK IT wing deleted an AI-generated video manipulating MK Stalins voice and image after sparking controversy, and the office should monitor deepfake regulations.
The IMD stated a low-pressure area over the Bay of Bengal will intensify into Cyclone Murasu bringing heavy rain, and the office should prepare relief measures.
